server.title: Sign in
server.invalid: That is not the address of a server, such as files.example.com.
server.unreachable: {server} is not a Transferly server, or it cannot be reached.

approval.title: Approve in your browser
approval.opened: Your browser opened this address. Sign in there and approve transferly-tui on {host}.
approval.notOpened: Open this address in your browser, sign in there and approve transferly-tui on {host}.
approval.noBrowser: No browser here? Press p and paste the code the page shows.
approval.keys: o open again · c copy · p paste a code · Esc back
approval.denied: The sign-in was denied in the browser.

paste.title: Paste the code
paste.intro: Open this address on any device, sign in and approve:
paste.then: Then paste the code the page shows.
paste.note: The code works once, for 5 minutes.

exchange.invalid_grant: The code is not valid any more: it works once, for 5 minutes. Sign in again.
exchange.cli_login_disabled: This server has signing in from the terminal turned off; ask its administrator.
exchange.http_404: This server is too old to sign in from the terminal: update it.
exchange.notKept: Signed in, but the token could not be kept: {reason}

main.small: Make the window at least 60 × 16 to use the client.
main.noSites: No sites in this workspace yet. Add them in the web.
main.versions: server {server}, client {client}: update the one behind
main.tooOld: This server is too old for that: update it.
main.ended: The session ended. Sign in again.
main.notSaved: The settings could not be kept: {reason}
main.keysSites: Enter open · w workspace · / commands · ? help · q quit
main.keysExplorer: Enter open · Space mark · n folder · F2 rename · Del delete · f filter · o show · ? help
main.keysQueue: p pause · x cancel · R resume · [ ] tabs · ? help

commands.title: Commands
commands.hint: ↑↓ choose · Tab complete · Enter run · Esc close
commands.config: settings: language, theme, colors, keys of files
commands.theme: wear another theme, shared with the web
commands.language: English or Español, shared with the web
commands.server: switch to another server or add one

settings.title: Settings
settings.keys: ↑↓ choose · ←→ change · Enter list · Esc close
settings.timezoneWeb: The time zone is changed in the web, in Settings.
settings.note: Settings of the account follow it to the web and every computer; the others stay on this one.

vault.title: Unlock the vault
vault.intro: Your vault is locked. Enter your master password to unlock it for this session.
vault.forSite: The credentials of {site} are in your vault. Enter your master password to unlock it for this session.
vault.wrong: That master password is not right.
vault.limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

help.title: Keys
help.keys: type to filter · ↑↓ scroll · Esc close
help.show: show the local disk or a site
help.page: page up or down, top, bottom
help.clear: clear the marks, then the filter
help.sort: sort by name, size or date; reverse
help.clearWord: clear the field, erase a word

explorer.choose: Press o to show the local disk or a site here.
explorer.name: Name
explorer.deleteBody: Delete {count} entries? Folders go with everything in them.

errors.vault_locked: The vault is locked: unlock it to open the site.
errors.host_key_unknown: The key of this server is not trusted yet.
errors.host_key_changed: The key of this server changed since it was trusted.
errors.not_found: It does not exist any more.
errors.already_exists: Something with that name already exists.
errors.permission_denied: The server does not let this account do that.
errors.connection_failed: The server could not be reached.
errors.auth_failed: The server refused the credentials of the site.
errors.forbidden: Your role in this workspace does not allow that.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.credentials_required: This site asks for its password.
errors.partly_failed: Some files of the folder failed; the queue shows which.

hostKey.title: Trust this server?
hostKey.changedTitle: The key of this server changed
hostKey.intro: First connection to {site}. Trust its key only if the fingerprint is the one of the server:
hostKey.changedIntro: The key of {site} is not the one trusted. If nobody changed the server, someone may be in the middle.
hostKey.check: Ask the administrator of the server for its fingerprint, or compare it with the one in the web.
hostKey.changedKeys: a trust it too · r replace · Esc cancel

password.title: Password of {site}
password.intro: This site asks for its password when connecting. It is kept in memory for this session only.

prompt.title: {site} asks
prompt.intro: The server asks before letting this account in.
prompt.keys: Tab next · Enter send · Esc refuse

log.title: Connection log
log.empty: Nothing yet: the steps of connections to sites show here.

copy.title: Copy
copy.keys: Enter copy · ← → if it exists · Esc cancel
copy.noTarget: The other panel shows nothing: press o there to choose where to copy.
copy.localToLocal: Both panels show the local disk: copy between this computer and a site, or between sites.
copy.skipped: {count} left out: they exist at the destination.

transfers.title: Transfers ({count} running)
transfers.empty: No transfers yet: F5 or c copies to the other panel.
transfers.queueKeys: p pause · x cancel · R resume · + - priority · [ ] tabs
transfers.cancelBody: Cancel {name}? What was moved stays as it is.
